'''Dervin''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Dervin was one of the [[Vault 32 raider]]s who, under [[Lee Moldaver]]'s orders, infiltrated [[Vault 32]] and participated in the Triennial Trade with Vault 33.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Head]]===
Sometime after being imprisoned with his fellow Vault 32 raiders in a room within Vault 33, Dervin and his fellow raiders are served trays of food by [[Marianne (TV series)|Marianne]].

During a meeting led by the Vault 33 Council with the Vault 33 dwellers about the Vault 32 raiders, Dervin is seen scarfing down a tray of food served to him and his fellow raiders.

===[[The Ghouls]]===
Dervin could be seen through the window when Norm was ordered to deliver a jello cake to the Vault 32 raiders. After some slices were passed through the door hatch, the remainder of the cake was taken by [[Veronica (TV series)|Veronica]]. Through the hatch on the door, Dervin interacts with Norm, asking what he's looking at, to which he answers, a murderer in a cage who took the innocent lives of Vault 33 and 32 dwellers. Before Norm could close the hatchway to the door, Dervin alludes that the raiders weren't the ones who killed the Vault 32 residents and claims whatever they were up to wasn't innocent.

What Dervin told Norm would inspire him to investigate Vault 32 with the assistance of his cousin [[Chet (TV series)|Chet]].

===[[The Radio]]===
Dervin is briefly seen sitting down at a table with two other Vault 32 raiders, scarfing down food.

Eventually, the Vault 32 raiders would all perish because someone put rat poison in their food, and [[Veronica (TV series)|Veronica]] was blamed for it.

==Personality==
Like his fellow raiders, Dervin was a psychotic killer who had nearly no sympathy for others who stood in his way. However, Dervin was honest toward Norm that he and his fellow raiders weren't the ones who killed the original [[Vault 32 dweller]]s.

==Notable quotes==
* {{Inline quote|I don't know what the people of Vault 32 were up to. But it was anything but innocent}}
